description: Set when the call for papers and registration open and close. Use it to open a CFP, extend a deadline, or close registration. Send only the bounds you are changing. IMPORTANT: null and omitted mean different things — pass null to REMOVE a deadline (leaving that window open with no end), and omit the field entirely to leave it as it is. So "reopen the CFP" means passing submissionClose: null, not an empty call. A close date must be after its matching open date. Opening a CFP has a real effect: authors can submit from that moment, so confirm the dates with the user first. Returns the merged stored windows, which answers "is the CFP open now?" directly. Requires the user to be an admin of that specific conference, and an OAuth connection rather than an API key. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

submissionClose.description: ISO 8601 submission deadline, or null to remove it (CFP stays open). Omit to leave unchanged.

submissionOpen.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the CFP opens, or null to remove the bound. Omit to leave unchanged.

name: set_conference_windows
title: Open or close the call for papers and registration
